John says the Word was with God and was God. What does this teach you about who Jesus is?
To all who received him, Jesus gave the right to become children of God. What does it mean to be God's child?
"The Word became flesh and dwelt among us." Why does it matter that God came so close?
John pointed away from himself to "the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world." How can you point others to Jesus?
Philip told Nathanael, "Come and see." Who could you invite to come and see Jesus?
Jesus turned water into wine at a wedding. What does this first sign show about him?
Mary said, "Do whatever he tells you." What is Jesus telling you to do?
Jesus cleared the temple with zeal for his Father's house. What does this show about how he cares for true worship?
Jesus spoke of raising "this temple" in three days. Why did the disciples only understand after the resurrection?
Jesus told Nicodemus, "You must be born again." What does new birth by the Spirit mean?
Jesus compares himself to the bronze serpent lifted up in the wilderness. What does it mean to look to him?
Read John 3:16 slowly. Which word or phrase speaks to you most today?
Jesus says people loved darkness rather than light. What would it mean to step into the light?
John said, "He must increase, but I must decrease." Where does Jesus need to increase in your life?
Jesus offered living water to the Samaritan woman. What thirst in you can only Jesus satisfy?
Jesus says true worshippers worship in spirit and truth. What does that look like for you?
The woman went and told her town, "Come, see a man who told me all that I ever did." What could you tell others about Jesus?
Jesus says the fields are white for harvest. Who around you might be ready to hear?
The official believed Jesus' word and went home. What does it mean to trust Jesus' word before you see the result?
Jesus asked the man, "Do you want to be healed?" Why might Jesus ask this question?
Jesus said, "My Father is working until now, and I am working." What does this show about Jesus' relationship with the Father?
Whoever hears Jesus' word and believes has eternal life. What does this promise mean to you?
The Scriptures bear witness about Jesus. How has reading Scripture helped you know him better?
A boy's five loaves and two fish fed five thousand. What small thing can you give to Jesus?
Jesus came to them on the water and said, "It is I; do not be afraid." What fear do you need him to speak into?
Jesus says, "I am the bread of life." What are you hungry for that only Jesus can fill?
Jesus speaks of giving his flesh for the life of the world. What does his sacrifice mean for you?
Peter said, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life." Why do you keep following Jesus?
Even Jesus' brothers did not believe in him. What does this show about the difficulty of faith close to home?
Jesus says whoever wants to do God's will will know whether his teaching is from God. How does obedience help understanding?
Jesus cried, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink." What does the Spirit's living water mean for you?
People were divided about Jesus. Why does Jesus divide opinion, and where do you stand?
Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more." How does grace lead to change?
Jesus says, "I am the light of the world." Where do you need his light in your life?
"The truth will set you free." What does Jesus set you free from?
Jesus says, "Before Abraham was, I am." What does this claim reveal about him?
The disciples asked who sinned; Jesus said this happened so God's works might be displayed. How does this change how you see suffering?
The healed man held to what he knew: "I was blind, now I see." What has Jesus done in your life that you can simply tell?
The man was thrown out for speaking about Jesus. What does following Jesus cost in your life?
Jesus found the man and he worshipped. What does it mean to truly see who Jesus is?
The sheep hear the shepherd's voice and follow. How do you recognise Jesus' voice?
Jesus came that we may have life abundantly. What does abundant life with him look like?
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep. What does this show about how Jesus cares for you?
No one will snatch Jesus' sheep out of his hand. What comfort does this give you?
Jesus loved Martha, Mary and Lazarus, yet he waited. Why might Jesus delay when he loves us?
Jesus said, "I am the resurrection and the life." What does this mean for you when facing death?
Jesus wept at the tomb. What does his weeping show about how he enters our grief?
Jesus called, "Lazarus, come out." What does this sign point to about Jesus' power?
Caiaphas said one man should die for the people. How did God turn those words into the gospel?
Mary anointed Jesus' feet with costly perfume. What does extravagant love for Jesus look like?
The crowds welcomed Jesus as King with palm branches. What kind of King did they expect, and what kind did they get?
Jesus says a grain of wheat must die to bear fruit. What does this mean for your life?
Jesus said, "When I am lifted up, I will draw all people to myself." How does the cross draw people?
Some believed but loved the glory of men more than the glory of God. Where do you feel that pull?
Jesus, knowing who he was, washed his disciples' feet. What does this show about his love?
Jesus said, "You also ought to wash one another's feet." Whose "feet" can you serve this week?
Jesus knew Judas would betray him yet still washed his feet. What does this show about Jesus?
"Love one another: just as I have loved you." How can people tell you are Jesus' disciple?
Jesus told Peter he would deny him. How does Jesus know us fully and still love us?
"Let not your hearts be troubled." What is troubling your heart, and what does Jesus promise?
Jesus says, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life." What does this mean for you?
Jesus says, "Whoever has seen me has seen the Father." What do you learn about God by looking at Jesus?
Jesus promised the Helper, the Holy Spirit. How have you experienced the Spirit's help?
Jesus gives a peace not as the world gives. Where do you need his peace?
"Abide in me." What helps you stay connected to Jesus day by day?
Jesus wants his joy to be in you and your joy to be full. What keeps you from that joy?
Jesus calls his disciples friends. What does friendship with Jesus mean to you?
Jesus warns the world may hate his followers. How does this prepare you when faith is unpopular?
Jesus says it is good that he goes away so the Helper will come. Why is the Spirit's coming such a gift?
The Spirit will guide you into all the truth. How can you depend on the Spirit when you read the Bible?
Jesus says your sorrow will turn into joy. Where are you waiting for that?
"In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world." What does this mean for you today?
Jesus says eternal life is knowing the Father and the Son. How are you growing in knowing God?
Jesus prayed for his disciples to be kept and made holy. What does it mean that Jesus prays for you?
Jesus prayed for all who would believe, that they may be one. How can you help the church be one?
Jesus wants his followers to be with him and see his glory. What does this hope mean to you?
Jesus stepped forward and said, "I am he." What does his calm surrender show about him?
Peter denied Jesus while warming himself by the fire. When are you tempted to hide your faith?
Pilate asked, "What is truth?" How would you answer Pilate?
Jesus said, "My kingdom is not of this world." What kind of kingdom does he bring?
The crowd chose Barabbas. What does it mean that Jesus took the place of the guilty?
Jesus was crowned with thorns and mocked as King. Why did he endure this?
Pilate's sign read "Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews." In what way was it true?
From the cross Jesus cared for his mother. What does this show about his love?
Jesus said, "It is finished." What did Jesus finish on the cross?
Joseph and Nicodemus came out of hiding to bury Jesus. What gave them courage?
Peter and John ran to the empty tomb. What would you have thought if you'd seen it?
Jesus called Mary by name and she knew him. What does it mean that Jesus knows you by name?
Jesus said, "As the Father has sent me, even so I am sending you." Where is he sending you?
Thomas said, "My Lord and my God!" How does Jesus meet you in your doubts?
John wrote so that you may believe and have life. How has John's Gospel strengthened your faith?
The risen Jesus made breakfast for his tired disciples. What does this show about his care?
Jesus asked Peter three times, "Do you love me?" and then said, "Feed my lambs." How would you answer Jesus?
Jesus told Peter what following would cost, then said, "Follow me." What does following him mean for you?
Jesus told Peter not to compare himself with John. Where are you tempted to compare your path with others?
